title: RBAC v2 draft role-to-permission matrix (Hosted/Dedicated/Private applicability)
body:
RBAC v2 ROLE MATRIX — DRAFT (sheet-style)
Last updated: 2025-03-21 (Naomi)

Purpose
- Working role-to-permission matrix used to:
  (a) align Security/Platform/Product on least-privilege defaults
  (b) drive built-in role templates in rbac-policy-bundle
  (c) support migration mapping from RBAC v1 coarse roles
- Columns include applicability per deployment mode (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) + notes on default mapping and scope expectations.

Legend
- Applicability: Y = applicable, N = not applicable, Partial = only in some environments / behind feature flag / specific SKU
- Scope: org | project | env | cluster
- “Default mapping” refers to proposed mapping of RBAC v1 roles (Owner/Admin/Member/Viewer) -> RBAC v2 templates during migration.
- Permissions listed are canonical strings (draft naming) and may still change due to ADR-014 naming/versioning.

TAB 1 — Role templates (draft)
Columns: Role | Hosted | Dedicated | Private | Primary scope(s) | Who uses it | Default mapping (RBAC v1) | Notes

Org Admin | Y | Y | Y | org | Org owners / platform admins | v1:Owner -> Org Admin | Broad but not omnipotent: does NOT grant break-glass or billing payment instrument by default; can manage users/roles/projects; can manage API keys at org+project scopes.
Security Admin | Y | Y | Y | org | Security team / security champions | v1:Owner/Admin -> Security Admin (opt-in) | Separation-of-duties role. Owns audit log config/export, retention controls, SSO settings, break-glass approvals (where supported).
Billing Admin | Y | Y | Partial | org | Finance / procurement | v1:Owner/Admin -> Billing Admin (opt-in) | Private: depends on contract model; some Private deployments have no in-product billing UI.
Project Admin | Y | Y | Y | project | App/team leads | v1:Admin -> Project Admin | Can manage project members, project API keys, model pinning/rollouts within project. Cannot change org-wide SSO or retention.
Developer (Project) | Y | Y | Y | project | Engineers building apps | v1:Member -> Developer | Can create/manage their own API keys (if allowed), view usage, create deployments/routes in project if product requires it; cannot change org roles.
Read-only Auditor | Y | Y | Y | org (+project) | Internal/external auditors | v1:Viewer -> Read-only Auditor | View-only across org, including audit logs (read), security settings (read), routing policies (read). Export audit logs may be separate permission (see notes).
Support / Solutions Engineer (Scoped) | Partial | Partial | Partial | org/project (time-bound) | Redwood internal only | none | Intended for internal operations with explicit customer approval; typically disabled for customers; always logged; may require break-glass.
Routing Policy Editor | Y | Y | Y | env/project | Platform operators | none (new) | Narrow role for managing routing policies, fallback policies, region selection; frequently requested by enterprise (separate from user/role admins).
Deployment Operator (Dedicated) | N | Y | Partial | env/cluster | Dedicated ops / customer SRE | none (new) | Dedicated GPU pool ops: scale, drain, maintenance windows. Private applicability depends on whether customer uses Redwood-managed clusters.
Private Deployment Operator | N | Partial | Y | cluster | Customer infra/ops | none (new) | Manage Private cluster lifecycle, upgrades, cert rotation (where exposed), view cluster health; cannot edit org users unless also bound.
Private Installer / Bootstrap Admin | N | N | Y | cluster (+org bootstrap) | First-install admin | none (install-time) | Special bootstrap binding created by installer; should be migrated to explicit org/cluster role bindings post-install; must support safe recovery path.
Key Manager | Y | Y | Y | org/project | Security ops | none (new) | Manage secrets and key rotation (API keys, signing keys where applicable); distinct from Project Admin to support SoD.

TAB 2 — Permissions reference (grouped)
Columns: Permission | Description | Sensitivity | Hosted | Dedicated | Private | Typical roles | Notes

# Org + identity management
org.users.list | List users in org | Med | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin, Security Admin, Read-only Auditor | Used by Console user picker.
org.users.invite | Invite user to org | High | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin | Triggers email; audit event required.
org.users.deactivate | Deactivate/suspend user | High | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin, Security Admin | Prefer 2-person rule? (open question).
org.groups.read | Read IdP group mappings (if supported) | Med | Y | Y | Y | Security Admin, Org Admin, Read-only Auditor | Private customers ask for evidence of group->role mapping.
org.groups.write | Modify IdP group mappings | High | Y | Y | Y | Security Admin | Guardrails: require recent re-auth (Console).
org.roles.list | List roles | Low | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin, Project Admin, Read-only Auditor | Includes built-in and custom roles.
org.roles.create | Create custom role | High | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin, Security Admin | May be limited in early v2 rollout (feature-flag).
org.roles.update | Update custom role | High | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin, Security Admin | Must bump policy version; cache invalidation required.
org.roles.delete | Delete custom role | High | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin, Security Admin | Must ensure no active bindings.
org.role_bindings.list | List role bindings | Med | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin, Security Admin, Read-only Auditor | Needed for “who has access” reporting.
org.role_bindings.create | Create role binding | High | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin, Security Admin | Scope validation is critical.
org.role_bindings.delete | Delete role binding | High | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin, Security Admin | High-risk; can lock out admins.
org.permission_viewer.read | View permission catalog + diffs | Low | Y | Y | Y | All admins, Read-only Auditor | Supports “why denied” and customer evidence.

# Project management
project.create | Create a project | Med | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin | Some customers want Security Admin to be able to create projects (open).
project.read | Read project details | Low | Y | Y | Y | All project roles, Auditor | Should be broadly granted.
project.update | Update project settings | Med | Y | Y | Y | Project Admin | Includes naming, quotas (if exposed).
project.delete | Delete project | High | Y | Y | Y | Org Admin | Often protected by additional confirmation.
project.members.list | List project members | Low | Y | Y | Y | Project Admin, Developer, Auditor | 
project.members.add | Add member to project | High | Y | Y | Y | Project Admin | Might be constrained by org policy.
project.members.remove | Remove member from project | High | Y | Y | Y | Project Admin | 

# API keys + tokens
api_keys.list | List API keys | Med | Y | Y | Y | Project Admin, Key Manager | Keys are sensitive metadata.
api_keys.create | Create API key | High | Y | Y | Y | Project Admin, Developer (optional), Key Manager | Many enterprises require Devs cannot create org-wide keys.
api_keys.rotate | Rotate API key | Critical | Y | Y | Y | Key Manager, Project Admin | Tied to support tickets for 403s; must be covered by integration tests.
api_keys.revoke | Revoke API key | High | Y | Y | Y | Key Manager, Project Admin | 
api_keys.read_secret | View key secret once (if allowed) | Critical | Y | Y | Y | Key Manager | Prefer “create returns secret, never view again” pattern.

# Model + routing policy controls
models.catalog.read | Read model catalog | Low | Y | Y | Y | Developer, Project Admin, Auditor | 
models.pinning.update | Pin model version for project/env | High | Y | Y | Y | Project Admin | Impacts production output.
models.rollouts.create | Create rollout (canary/A-B) | High | Y | Y | Y | Project Admin, Routing Policy Editor | Requires “rollback” permission? (open)
models.rollouts.rollback | Roll back rollout | High | Y | Y | Y | Project Admin, Routing Policy Editor | 
routing_policies.read | Read routing policies | Med | Y | Y | Y | Routing Policy Editor, Auditor, Project Admin | Sensitive: reveals infra topology.
routing_policies.update | Update routing policies | Critical | Y | Y | Y | Routing Policy Editor | One of the most sensitive actions; requires strong audit logging.
fallback_policies.update | Update fallback policies/model variants | High | Y | Y | Y | Routing Policy Editor | Must prevent cross-project impact.
rate_limits.update | Update per-project rate limits | High | Y | Y | Y | Project Admin, Org Admin | Potential abuse; ties to cost controls.

# Audit logging + evidence
audit_logs.read | Read audit logs in Console/API | Med | Y | Y | Y | Security Admin, Read-only Auditor | Read-only should be common.
audit_logs.export | Export audit logs (download / SIEM push) | High | Y | Y | Y | Security Admin | Separate from read to support least privilege.
audit_logs.retention.read | Read retention settings | Med | Y | Y | Y | Security Admin, Auditor | 
audit_logs.retention.update | Update retention settings | High | Y | Y | Y | Security Admin | Enterprise requirement.
audit_logs.siem_config.update | Configure SIEM export | High | Y | Y | Y | Security Admin | Private may export locally.

# Security settings
sso.settings.read | Read SSO/SAML/OIDC settings | Med | Y | Y | Y | Security Admin, Auditor | 
sso.settings.update | Update SSO/SAML/OIDC settings | Critical | Y | Y | Y | Security Admin | “lockout risk” warning required.
security.break_glass.request | Request break-glass elevation | Critical | Partial | Partial | Partial | Org Admin (request), Support (internal) | Some environments only; always logged/alerted.
security.break_glass.approve | Approve break-glass | Critical | Partial | Partial | Partial | Security Admin, SecOps | Might require two approvers.

# Dedicated capacity management (Dedicated SKU)
dedicated.pools.read | Read dedicated pool status | Med | N | Y | Partial | Deployment Operator (Dedicated), Org Admin | Private only if customer uses Redwood-managed pools.
dedicated.pools.scale | Scale dedicated pool | Critical | N | Y | Partial | Deployment Operator (Dedicated) | Strong guardrails; impacts spend/availability.
dedicated.maintenance.schedule | Schedule maintenance | High | N | Y | Partial | Deployment Operator (Dedicated) | 

# Private deployment / cluster operations
private.cluster.read | Read cluster config + health | Med | N | Partial | Y | Private Deployment Operator, Auditor | 
private.cluster.upgrade | Upgrade private deployment | Critical | N | N | Y | Private Deployment Operator | Requires preflight checks.
private.cluster.secrets.rotate | Rotate cluster secrets/certs | Critical | N | N | Y | Private Deployment Operator, Key Manager | Some secret operations may be split.
private.installer.bootstrap_admin.manage | Manage bootstrap admin binding | Critical | N | N | Y | Private Installer / Bootstrap Admin | Should be time-boxed and removed post-setup.

TAB 4 — Default mapping proposals (migration notes)
- RBAC v1 Owner:
  - Proposed: Org Admin + Project Admin (for all projects) + (optional) Security Admin (NOT default)
  - Rationale: avoid auto-granting high-risk Security Admin powers (SSO updates, SIEM config) unless explicitly needed.

- RBAC v1 Admin:
  - Proposed: Project Admin (scoped to existing projects) + (optional) Routing Policy Editor for env-level routing if they currently have it
  - Rationale: many “admins” today are app owners; keep scope limited.

- RBAC v1 Member:
  - Proposed: Developer (per project) with api_keys.create = OFF by default for regulated orgs; ON by default for self-serve startups (feature flag / org setting?)
  - Open question: Do we need an org-level policy toggle “Allow developers to create API keys”?

- RBAC v1 Viewer:
  - Proposed: Read-only Auditor (org scope)
  - Note: audit_logs.export should remain Security Admin only by default (frequent SoD requirement).

Known gaps / open questions (as of 2025-03-21)
1) Audit export: do we allow Read-only Auditor to export by default? Security says NO; some customers say auditors need exports. Possible compromise: separate “Audit Exporter” role (read + export only).
2) Routing policies: should Project Admin get routing_policies.update by default? Product leaning NO; create explicit Routing Policy Editor role to avoid accidental outages.
3) SSO update lockout risk: require step-up auth + two-person approval? (likely later; capture in break-glass/controls doc).
4) Private bootstrap admin: ensure it cannot be used as a persistent super-admin; implement time-bound binding + mandatory follow-up checklist.
5) Permission granularity for viewing API keys: list vs view metadata vs view secret. Current stance: never allow viewing secret after creation.

Change log (short)
- 2025-02-07: initial matrix created after permission workshop (Naomi + Marcus)
- 2025-02-26: added Dedicated + Private operator roles, added applicability columns (Vivek/Colin input)
- 2025-03-12: split audit_logs.read vs audit_logs.export; added SIEM config perms (Kevin)
- 2025-03-21: tightened default mapping for v1 Owner/Admin; marked several Security Admin actions as not default (Marcus)

Notes to self / next edits
- Align permission strings with permission registry in redwood/pr-28134 (once merged); reconcile naming differences.
- After endpoint audit (ENG-18241) finalize which permissions are required for: key rotation, routing policy edits, audit export, SSO updates.
- Feed final role templates into rbac-policy-bundle YAML generator and add Hosted/Dedicated/Private examples.
